notes:
K8Secret 0.6.21 — three things you reported.

The replica editor could get permanently stuck. It armed itself for the number you typed before asking you to confirm, and only disarmed once the cluster actually reached that number — so if you cancelled the confirmation, or the scale was refused, Apply silently stopped working for that value and never started again. Cancelling now properly puts the control back, a refused scale does too, and Esc reverts the field instead of stranding you in it.

Port forwards can take a path. A forwarded port is rarely useful at its root — your dashboard is at /admin/queues, your API's docs at /docs — so there is now a path field beside the Port Forward button. Set it once and it is remembered for that service, in that namespace, in that cluster, and every later click opens straight there.

Sending feedback fills in the issue title. It only prefilled the body before, and GitHub will not create an issue without a title, so you were left inventing one — or typing your whole report into the title and losing the diagnostics. The title now comes from what you wrote, and the full text still goes in the body.

Thanks to sourav-orbital for all three.
